notes.title: Update v1.3 - Anomaly Edition
notes.notes:
Mystic Watcher’s first big update!  

- A lot of anomalies have been changed and fixed  
- Updated anomaly photos  
- Added yes or no options when quitting the game  
- Added a skip dialogue option  
- Changed the cursor  
- Removed the Christmas Decorations (in a timely fashion...totally :> )  
- Adjusted the difficulties  
- Changed the menu box on the desktop  
- Fixed some art  
- Fixed some bugs with the animations  
- Enjoy and good luck finding those anomalies!!!  

Thank you for all your support, we hope to continue updating Mystic Watcher in the future :D Enjoy and good luck reporting those anomalies!!!
